components.name: Aurora
components.description: Aurora — soft light bands flowing across the top of the canvas (2.6 Backgrounds). Decorative only (BGR-01). Tone Neutral (accent/soft + fill tokens) / Brand (gradient/brand-*). Gradient stops are bound to colour tokens. Intensity = band layer opacity (.35 · .6 · .9). Best for hero and auth screens with text in the lower half. React: <Aurora tone intensity speed bands />.

Aurora.text:
ASSETS · BACKGROUNDS
BEK
Design System
2.6 Backgrounds · Aurora
Soft light bands flowing across the top of the canvas. Leaves the lower half calm for headlines and actions — made for auth and landing heroes.
Overview
Two tones × three intensities (6 variants).
Neutral
Bands from accent/soft, fill/soft-pressed, fill/strong and accent/default.
Brand
Bands from gradient/brand-start → gradient/brand-end and accent/default.
Anatomy
Base
bg/base
Bands
Three rotated ellipses with linear gradients — stops bound to colour tokens
Blur
Layer blur 64 per band
Flow
In code bands slide and sway on slow loops (15–30 s)
Intensity
Preset strength. In code every value is a prop; presets are starting points.
Subtle
bands opacity .35.
Default
bands opacity .6.
Intense
bands opacity .9 — covers only.
Usage
Rules BGR-01 … BGR-06 (see Matrix rain) apply to every background on this page.
• Put headline and CTA in the lower half; bands sit in the upper 60 %.
• On mobile use Subtle — bands read stronger on small screens.
• Gradient stops are token-bound, so Brand updates with the brand palette.
Devices
Instances resize freely — content scales, edges clip. Keep text in a calm area (BGR-02).
